title: Replace packages/ui's hand-authored ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.yaml with TSDoc tags (@layer/@status/@example) read directly from src/index.ts
objective: Owner-directed: 'esse arquivo aqui nao da, preciso de opcoes melhores e mais automaticas' (packages/ui/documentation/mesh/ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.yaml). Owner confirmed (after being shown 3 concrete options) they want a TSDoc/JSDoc comment-block convention -- pasting a @param/@return-style example -- rather than any side file. This eliminates the separate meta file entirely: summary already exists as the TSDoc description on each exported component function in packages/ui/src/index.ts; add @layer and @status tags (single line each) and one-or-more @example <title> tags containing a fenced ```tsx block for the snippet. export-doc-mesh.mjs stops reading a YAML/JSON meta file and instead parses these tags directly from the same TS source it already walks with the compiler API for props. The generated docs/generated/meshes/ui-doc-mesh.v1.json schema and every downstream consumer (architecture-studio's generate-stories.mjs, Storybook) stay unchanged -- only the hand-authored input moves from a parallel file into the code's own doc comments, and js-yaml becomes an unused dependency to remove.
validations: DONE: added @layer/@status/@example (fenced ```tsx block) TSDoc tags to all 7 exported components in packages/ui/src/index.ts; folded each component's better-worded editorial summary (previously only in the YAML) back into the TSDoc description line itself, so it now serves both TypeDoc and the doc-mesh with no duplication.

DONE: export-doc-mesh.mjs rewritten to parse these tags as plain leading-trivia text (not TS's JSDoc tag AST, to avoid any risk of JSX inside a fenced block being mangled by a comment parser not designed to carry JSX verbatim) -- same manual-parse style already used in this script for prop extraction. js-yaml import removed.

DONE: regenerated docs/generated/meshes/ui-doc-mesh.v1.json and diffed against the previous YAML-driven output -- every JSX snippet is byte-identical; only example ids changed their derivation (kebab-case of the @example title instead of a hand-picked slug -- nothing downstream reads or compares these ids) and GridLayout's summary now also carries its pre-existing multi-paragraph consumer note (harmless -- generate-stories.mjs never reads summary).

DONE: apps/architecture-studio's generate-stories.mjs regenerated all 7 story files from the new mesh; diffed -- only the header comment and the auto-derived story-const name changed (e.g. ButtonDefault -> DefaultButton), matching the id-derivation change above. Storybook dev server (already running on :6006) hot-reloaded the new story content with no restart needed; curled /index.json and confirmed all 7 stories present under their new ids.
DONE: js-yaml removed from packages/ui/package.json; pnpm install run at workspace root, confirmed 2 packages dropped, no supply-chain gate exception needed this time.

DONE: ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.yaml deleted; packages/ui/project.json's docs-mesh-export inputs and README.md's docs-mesh-export description updated to describe the TSDoc convention (with a worked example) instead of the removed file.

DONE: packages/ui tsc --noEmit clean; node --test tests/*.test.mjs 9/9 pass; api-check flagged intentional baseline drift (doc-comment text only, no signature change -- diffed and confirmed), updated via the documented UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=yes flow, re-ran clean afterward.

DONE: regenerated docs/generated/api/ts/ui.api.md (protocol step 6, src/ touched) and ran the docs-quality-check skill against it: not a size outlier vs siblings (503 lines vs x6-canvas's 493), no empty/failed-extraction signal, good doc-coverage ratio, no formatting artifacts. Side note (not a blocker, pre-existing generator behavior, not introduced by this task): generate-api-docs.mjs's commentText() only reads TypeDoc's comment.summary, so the new @layer/@status/@example tags don't render in this human-readable file even though they're fully preserved in the raw baseline and fully consumed by the mesh/Storybook pipeline -- left as a suggestion for a future, separate task.
artifacts: packages/ui/src/index.ts (TSDoc @layer/@status/@example tags added to all 7 exported components; summaries folded in from the removed YAML)
packages/ui/scripts/export-doc-mesh.mjs (parses doc comments directly from the AST; js-yaml dependency removed)
packages/ui/{package.json,project.json,README.md} (js-yaml dropped; docs-mesh-export description rewritten around the TSDoc convention)
packages/ui/tests/snapshots/public-api.md (intentionally updated baseline reflecting the new doc comments)
risks: Hand-rolled doc-comment parsing (not TS's JSDoc AST) is deliberately used to avoid any risk of TS's tag-comment parser mangling JSX inside fenced blocks the same way JSON string-escaping caused pain earlier this session -- this is a plain leading-trivia text parse with its own small grammar, same style already used for prop extraction in this script.

layer cannot be safely auto-derived from the component's underlying view file path (DataTable's view module lives under atoms/ despite being documented and treated as an organism layer), so @layer stays an explicit one-line tag rather than being inferred.

generate-api-docs.mjs's human-readable ui.api.md silently drops @layer/@status/@example content (renders only TypeDoc's comment.summary) -- pre-existing generator limitation, flagged as a suggestion, not fixed in this task.
